title: Chapter 3: The Tower and Nothing
summary: You reach the radio tower and climb to the top—only to find the transmitter empty. The signal and the light beam were a lie. By a rooftop campfire, Teacher's voice cuts through the static. Under the stars, Ringo and Xian open up about their guilt. Act one of the journey hits its turning point.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Fourth day, dusk. The RV stops beneath the broadcast tower. Rust-red steel, warning lights blinking steady, throwing rings of shadow on the wasteland. You chased that signal all this way—and here, you can't hear it. Like yelling until your throat's raw and realizing nobody was ever on the other side.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Wind pours through the tower frame, smelling of rust and old rain. When you step out, the door slam sounds too loud—like an announcement nobody asked for.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: ...It's tall. Is this where the light in the camera was coming from?

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Miles walks the base once, toeing cracks in the concrete, then looks up and counts fire-escape rungs. He keeps his voice low, like he's afraid to wake the silent metal skeleton.

scenes.speaker: xian
scenes.text: ...We're here. In the camera, the tower's... brighter than it looks.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Xian lies in the back, camera held steady. Through the lens the tower glows an unreal white—overexposed, or a promise that hasn't cashed yet.

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: I'm going up to check the roof. You... wait here. No—I'm not doing this alone this time.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: I'll stay with Xian. She needs her dressing changed—and someone should guard the RV down here.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Miles hands Ringo the first-aid kit and a thermos, then double-checks the walkie channel. The tower door hangs half-open, black as a well. Nobody says "be careful"—you've said it too many times already.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Elevator's dead. Only the fire escape left. Xian can't move. Inside it's pitch black, wind whistling through the gaps. You need to decide who stays with the RV and who climbs.

interactive.objective: [Objective] Climb decision: who stays, who goes up for the signal?
suggestions: Ringo and I go up. Xian stays in the RV—Miles changes her dressing.
I'll hit the roof alone. You two wait down here.
Ringo guards the RV. I'll take the camera up—Xian tells me what the lens sees.
interactive.aiGoal: Pre-climb decision. Ringo shouldn't shoulder it alone anymore (resolve growth). Miles stays with Xian. But someone has to reach the roof. Xian can guide through the camera remotely. Don't describe the rooftop yet—just assign roles and start the climb.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The metal ladder groans in the wind—every creak a reminder of how old this thing is. Higher up, the ruined city spreads out like scattered chess pieces. Ringo's breath echoes in the narrow shaft, sweat making the rail slick.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Halfway up you rest once. Over the walkie, Miles's voice, kept low: "Xian says there's light on the roof in the viewfinder. ...Tell me when you're there." Static cuts through, like words fished up from far away.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: Don't move. I'm done. ...They're almost at the top—can you check the lens again?

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The roof door is rust-stuck. You shoulder it open together. Metal screams and gives; wind rushes in—and then a silence that's hard to breathe in. Not empty because nobody's here. Empty because something should be.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Nothing on the roof. The transmitter lies tipped in a corner, every indicator dark. No adults. No answers. No host waiting for you. The signal was a dead machine echoing all along.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Wind tears across the open roof, whipping your clothes. The wasteland below glows in sunset like a dried-out sea—you swam so long just to reach the middle, with no shore.

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: ...We chased a signal... that wasn't even there?

scenes.speaker: xian
scenes.text: ...No. In the lens, someone was on the roof just now. They're gone.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Empty tower, dead transmitter, gunshot wounds and antibiotics spent—all of it led here, and here's nothing. Ringo crouches by the transmitter, shoulders starting to shake.

interactive.objective: [Objective] Facing the empty tower: steady Ringo, or admit this trip might have no answer
suggestions: No answer doesn't mean it was for nothing. Xian's still waiting for us to bring the meds back.
Ringo, get up—an empty tower is an answer too. The adults really are gone.
Don't fall apart yet. Let's go back to Xian. We'll figure it out together.
interactive.aiGoal: Empty tower emotional beat. Ringo dips into despair but doesn't fully break. After the player speaks, decide to stay on the roof for now—light a fire, wait for night. Miles can offer over the walkie to come up or bring supplies. Don't trigger any ending or cut to camp/reality layer.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: I'll bring some scrap wood up. ...Don't spend the whole night in this wind. Xian needs to hear you too.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Miles hauls a bundle of old wood and a tarp from the base, climbing faster than you'd expect. When he tops out, wind has his face flushed red, but he sets the wood down steady—like something someone should've done a long time ago.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: You build a fire from scrap on the roof. Flames sway in the night wind, throwing four shadows across the empty transmitter platform—a miniature of graduation camp night. Miles rigs the tarp against the wind, clumsy but serious about it.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The radio lights up on its own. In the static, a voice—not young, not old, borrowed from far away: "...You're here."

scenes.speaker: teacher
scenes.text: ...I'm jealous of you. You get to mess up. You don't have to be perfect.

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: Teacher...? Where are you? We've been looking for you so long—

scenes.speaker: xian
scenes.text: ...The voice isn't from the roof. It's from... the road we came on.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: ...Teacher, are you still listening? We... didn't do great. But we're still here.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: When Miles finishes, he nudges the walkie closer to the fire so Xian down below can hear. Wood pops; stars press down. For the first time in act one, everyone's listening—including you.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Ringo stares into the fire. Xian breathes over the radio. Miles feeds another log into the heart of it. On the roof, everyone's waiting for the same sentence.

interactive.objective: [Objective] Rooftop talk: answer Teacher, or open up Ringo/Xian's guilt
interactive.playerPrompt: What do you want to say?
suggestions: Teacher, we don't need perfect—we just need to still be together.
Ringo, getting shot wasn't your fault. Xian jumped in because she cares.
Xian, it's okay that pain came back. Being alive is enough.
interactive.aiGoal: Rooftop campfire long talk (Figma good-ending prelude). Teacher's voice can sigh once more but don't reveal meta/script truth. Ringo should touch her hesitation and guilt; Xian her self-doubt; Miles can briefly admit fear and stubbornness. After player comfort, everyone loosens up a little—but knots stay unresolved (knotResolved stays false). Don't cut to camp reunion or apartment ending.

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: ...I thought a captain can't be scared. But I am. I'm scared if I hesitate once more, I'll lose everyone.

scenes.speaker: xian
scenes.text: ...Me too. Scared of pain, of growing up, of you stopping the whole trip for me.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: ...Me too. Scared of saying the wrong thing, of being useless. But besides keeping going, I don't know what else to do.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The wind pauses. Wasteland below, stars above. No adults, no broadcast—just four kids and a fire. Maybe that's enough.

scenes.speaker: teacher
scenes.text: ...Go back down. The road's still under your feet.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Teacher's voice dissolves into static, like salt in night. Miles adds one last log without a word. Ringo buries her face in her knees, then lifts it—no audible sob, but her shoulders give her away.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The fire's almost out. One antibiotic dose left. Xian's fever dips, then climbs again. There's still road below; the ending isn't written—but you need one last call for tonight.

interactive.objective: [Objective] Chapter 3 finale: leave with Xian, or stay till dawn and search the tower base?
suggestions: Head down, back to the RV. Road's long—Xian can't keep freezing up here.
Search the tower base before dawn—maybe there's something under the empty top.
Ringo, all four of us made it this far. That's enough. Let's go home.
interactive.aiGoal: Chapter 3 wrap-up. Whatever the player picks, they decide to climb down and return to the RV—journey enters post-tower phase, ending branches about to open. Miles can help pack up. Don't play any specific ending (bad/normal/good/true/hidden).

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: You climb down from the broadcast tower. RV headlights cut the wasteland again. Miles looks back once—the fire's out, only stars left. The empty roof and the stars stay behind; at dawn, forked roads appear ahead—different choices, different endings. Chapter 3 ends here.

notes: Matches Figma: reach tower → empty rooftop → Teacher's sigh → campfire talk → act-one turning point. Miles stays with Xian then climbs for the fire. No specific ending triggered; routes live in endings chapter. Teacher is voice/silhouette only—no meta reveal.
